why: Amazon's agreement on November 23, 2026 to purchase the proprietary technology behind the Decart Optimization Stack and hire Decart's co-founders and engineering team in a deal valued at a reported $7.5 billion is a major consolidation in AI infrastructure. Integrating Decart's software-hardware optimization into AWS's custom Trainium chips via Annapurna Labs directly targets Nvidia's software moat and drew broad international press coverage.

set_aside.why: Anthropic's Claude Ship beta automates GitHub pull request reviews, fixes, and approvals for Team and Enterprise users, a notable developer tool behind Amazon's $7.5 billion silicon software deal.
Cisco and OpenAI's Shirudo open-source eBPF Linux runtime deploys temporary kernel shields before software patches land, an early security project of narrower scope than Amazon's Decart deal.
